abilities.name: Hunter's Mark
abilities.description: Reveal a non-Structure enemy and reduce their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds. passive Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal her for 1% of her maximum Health, doubled against targets with Hunter's Mark.; 20; trait

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier, Status effect / Healing
fields.notes: Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Light of Elune
abilities.description: Heal an ally Hero for 270. Light of Elune's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds every time Tyrande hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or damages an enemy Hero. Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.; 16 / 0.5

fields.notes: Basic Attacks trigger cooldown reduction from both Heroic and non-Heroic targets. Ability Damage only triggers cooldown reduction from Heroes. Casting Light of Elune sets the cooldown of Tyrande's next Basic Attack to 0.5 seconds, potentially causing it to come out slightly faster or slower depending on timing.

abilities.name: Sentinel
abilities.description: Send an Owl across the battleground revealing its path, dealing 120 damage to the first Hero hit, and revealing them for 5 seconds. If a Hero revealed by Sentinel dies, refresh its cooldown.

fields.notes: As Sentinel travels, it grants vision in a 7.0 x 7.0 area (increased by its hitbox) around the projectile that lasts for 4 seconds. Heroes hit by Sentinel grant vision in 8 radius around them for the duration of the revealed debuff.

abilities.name: Lunar Flare
abilities.description: After 0.75 seconds, deal 150 damage and Stun enemies in the target area for 0.75 seconds. Restores 25 Mana per enemy hit. quest Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 4%, up to 160%. After hitting 10 Heroes, increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%. reward After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit. reward After hitting 40 Heroes, every 8th Basic Attack fires a Lunar Flare, prioritizing Heroes.

abilities.name: Shadowstalk
abilities.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.; 90; 85; heroic

fields.notes: Heal over time persists even after Stealth has been broken.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.description: Deal 92 damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.; 80; 85; heroic

fields.notes: Casting Starfall sets the cooldown of Tyrande's next Basic Attack to 0.5 seconds, potentially causing it to come out slightly faster or slower depending on timing.

talents.name: Ranger
talents.description: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

fields.notes: Ranger increases Sentinel 's damage by 10% for every 2 units traveled, reaching the maximum bonus at 50 units. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Sentinel 's damage.

_raw_fields: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

talents.description: Cooldown 45 Activate to grant Tyrande and nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Tyrande's or her allies' Basic Attack damage.

fields.notes: Stacks additively with healing modifiers that affect Light of Elune 's healing output and multiplicatively with modifiers that affect healing received by the target.
